sn34.35-40:1.2: samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo.
sn34.35-40:1.3: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo.
sn34.35-40:1.4: neva samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo.
sn34.35-40:1.5: samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca.
